source: Stopped EOP IERS 20 C04 0hUTC ITRF2020/2000A, 23136 rows 1962-01-01 through 2025-05-05, SHA c17ba033b94de0b227250cad22f5ae41cfe03af4a049d46efa66b47872a42e27. sqrt/unweighted vector displacement in milliarcseconds. p=(1000*x,-1000*y) in east-positive terrestrial complex convention. GFZ mass+motion (x,y) dimensionless times 180*3600*1000/pi.
forcing: Operational AAM v1.0 and MPIOM OAM v1.0 3h UTC 00..21; HAM v1.2 (mass plus motion) and SLAM v1.2 (mass only) at 12 UTC as in two independent native time columns, conflicting with HAM textual 00 label. For this daily course use arithmetic mean of eight 3h AAM/OAM samples and own-day noon daily HAM/SLAM values as constant effective forcing in [day0,day1). This defines one common aggregation window, not a claim that every reported value integrates same physical interval. Exclude G-AHS, GAM, observed excitation and forecast products. No tide added. Files are already corrected in their respective release conventions; physical unmodeled tides/forcing remain in residual.
period_damping: T=434.2 days (embedded in published GFZ PDD), Q=179 fixed from Wilson/Vicente usage (not estimated). sigma=(2pi/T)*(1+i/2Q), p_dot=i*sigma*(p-chi). Baseline exact daily piecewise-constant convolution: p_next=chi+exp(i*sigma)*(p-chi). Candidate similarity transform S=R(lambda)diag(1,r)R(lambda)^T, lambda=-14.928509 deg EGM2008 zero tide, r=sqrt[A(C-A)/B(C-B)]=1.0033488856705037. Matrix for dynamics S*isotropic_daily*S^-1. This splice of rigid ellipticity and observed nonrigid T is an empirical reduced response, not Chen 2010 full frequency-dependent nonrigid filter.
schedule: 12 source years 2003–2014,10 target years 2015–2024. Each year conditions on C04 Jan1 only and evaluates Jan2–Dec31 inclusive. Same-day forcing integrated from Jan1 through Dec30. Source train and held sets disjoint. No target C04 rows except 10 declared Jan1 boundary vectors visible to predictor. Incoming forcing entire retrospective hindcast known. No fitted state or daily reset, no target detrending/smoothing. Score equally weighted years, days equally within each year; no independent-realization claim.
nuisance: Common source-only EQ excitation mean and optional linear secular trend + annual sine/cosine in each physical axis, identical reference dates/time units. Within each role fit by ordinary least squares across source trajectories, with equal total weight per calendar year. No held covariate target calibration. Candidate and main isotropic each fit all eight real coefficients (constant, trend, annual cos/sin separately per coordinate); condition and fitted coefficients reported. Free mode seeded by allowed Jan1 pole only.
roles: candidate triaxial with all four forcing sources and eight nuisance coefficients
isotropic with same four and same eight coefficients
90 degree orientation sham with same four and eight coefficients
axial isotropic published-period kernel plus four forcings and just two mean-excitation coefficients
annual+free isotropic with no geophysical forcing and eight coefficients
linear drift plus annual regression on source C04 and exact Jan1 offset
source-trained scalar multiplier on difference between first two roles optimizing year-balanced vector squared error on development, unconstrained real multiplier
gate: Primary metric equal-year mean of within-year daily Euclidean displacement RMSE in mas. Strict candidate win against every control, plus better than main isotropic and rotated sham in at least7/10 whole years each. Report all times/roles, mean radial absolute and Cartesian bias, worst absolute day and per-day predictions under all roles. Keep source-fold training advantage as descriptive; no mechanical attribution regardless of score. No post-target rescue.
access: Freeze original role code and inputs before source measurements. Hash all 10x8 complete forecast trajectories before held score. Exact source-law mathematical non-identifiability: for invertible chosen L, given p_dot=L(p-chi) permits chi=p-L^-1 p_dot. Unmeasured forcing absorbs changes of L; AAM/OAM share weather forcing and are not independent interventions. Same-input empirical trajectory comparison only. Prior Chen historical RMS & PSD results exposed. C04 formal uncertainties from release metadata exposed, numerical C04 positions and GFZ signal columns unopened at freeze.
